integrity: The 2015 optimal-cardinality Pearson theorem and 2016 two-reference systematic construction are explicitly credited as prior. The accepted contribution is the sharp one-check impossibility and the resulting exact systematic-versus-unrestricted minimal whole-symbol redundancy phase diagram. Algebraic proof applies to every q>=2,k>=1 and finite verifier is only corroborative.
scientific_limitations: Full finite alphabet, fixed-length message space and positive-affine Pearson confusability only; no noise performance or efficient nonsystematic encoding guarantee.
title: Exact systematicity gap for finite-alphabet Pearson codes
